claims.sentence: Participants will : * take a supplementation of omega-3 or placebo during 3 months * do a brain MRI * be interviewed for a dietary anamnesis * provide blood, stool and saliva samples * perform psychological tests and neuropsychological tasks Researchers will compare active comparator (omega-3) with placebo comparator (olive oil) to see if omega-3 can have a beneficial effect on AUD patients.
